LOOK: The Manila Traffic and Parking Bureau (MTPB) records 60,228 passengers who benefited from the Manila city government’s free ride program as of 2:30 p.m. on its first day on Monday, March 30. 

A total of 970 public utility jeepneys continue to drive various routes across the city, offering free rides to commuters for five days amid rising fuel prices. | 📸: Manila PIO/Facebook via John Andrei Gutierrez, https://t.co/E0yNJSWpUY trainee
